definitions.explanation: Taking a short break to rest or refresh oneself, especially during work or study.

examples.japanese: {息抜|いきぬ}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦コーヒー→コーヒー：00789_koohii⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I drink coffee as a break.

examples.japanese: ⟦たまに→たまに：01276_tamani⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{息抜|いきぬ}き⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Sometimes you need to take a breather too.

examples.japanese: ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合間|あいま}→合間：05708_aima⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{散歩|さんぽ}→散歩：02885_sanpo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{息抜|いきぬ}き⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I took a walk between study sessions to take a break.

notes:
{息抜|いきぬ}き means taking a short break from work or study to refresh oneself. Composed of ⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧ (breath) + ⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧ (to pull out/release), suggesting the image of releasing built-up tension.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {息抜|いきぬ}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to take a breather
- {息抜|いきぬ}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧〜⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do something as a break
- {息抜|いきぬ}き⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ: need a break
- ⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧{息抜|いきぬ}きになった: it was a nice break

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{気晴|きば}らし→気晴らし：16699_kibarashi⟧: diversion, doing something to lift one's mood
- ⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧: rest, break (more formal, scheduled)
- ⟦{一息|ひといき}→一息：07781_hitoiki⟧: a short pause, catching one's breath
- ⟦{気分転換|きぶんてんかん}→気分転換：08691_kibuntenkan⟧: change of pace, refreshing one's mood

USAGE:
{息抜|いきぬ}き emphasizes brief relaxation during a longer period of effort. Unlike ⟦{休憩|きゅうけい}→休憩：00262_kyuukei⟧ (which can be a scheduled or formal break), {息抜|いきぬ}き suggests a personal, informal moment of rest.
